title: Shop
howToEarn: Your agents earn you coins: +{{perTurn}} for every reply they finish, plus a bonus for the tools they use (up to {{cap}} a day).
offline: Can't reach the server right now. Coins and purchases will be back when you're online.
placeFromOffice: Go into an office to place it
lockedHint: Buy it in the shop with coins your agents earn

wallet.title: Coins · earned today {{today}} / {{cap}} · click to open the shop

account.codeBody: Your account has no password — this code is the key. It keeps your character, coins, purchases, team offices and arcade records. Enter it on another computer (or after reinstalling) to get everything back.
account.codeWarning: Keep it somewhere safe (e.g. a password manager). Anyone with the code can use your account; if you lose it, it can't be recovered.
account.restoreBody: Paste the recovery code from your other computer. This computer switches to that account.

error.server: The server had a problem. Try again.
error.unauthorized: That recovery code doesn't match any account.
error.bad_request: Something was wrong with that request.
error.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a little.
error.limit_reached: You already own the most copies allowed.
error.daily_limit: That's enough for today — the table opens again tomorrow.

limitNote: Limits per person: looks and maps 1 each; decorations 1–5 copies.
mapNote: Hidden maps: each comes with its own floor, walls and window view, 16 desks and a few shop decorations already in place. In a team office it changes only what you see.
